Now, there were three passengers in the carriage.

page_text_en:
He ran to the edge of a wheat field and shouted to the people harvesting wheat:

Listen carefully, everyone! No matter who asks you whose wheat field this is, you must answer that it belongs to the Marquis de Carabas!

If you get it wrong, you'll be chopped into little pieces, minced as fine as meat filling! But if you answer well, you'll receive a reward.

您的大名已经传遍了全世界。大家都信誓旦旦地跟我说，您天赋异禀，做出了不少让人目瞪口呆的壮举。所以呢，我就满怀尊敬地来亲眼瞧瞧，看看他们跟我说的是真是假。

好哇，你想瞧什么？我呀，一巴掌就能拍扁十只猫！就像碾死一只肮脏的小跳蚤那么容易。不过，我猜你对这种表演不感兴趣。

城堡的主人觉得这位不速之客有趣极了。就连老鼠们也躲在魁梧的食人魔身后，“吱吱吱”地议论起来。当然，他们只敢偷偷地笑，绝不敢跑到猫的面前来。
page_text_en:
Your great name has spread all over the world. Everyone has sworn to me that you are gifted and have done many astonishing feats. So, I've come here with great respect to see for myself whether what they say is true or false.

Well, what do you want to see? I, for one, can flatten ten cats with a single slap! As easy as crushing a dirty little flea. But I guess you're not interested in this kind of performance.

The castle's master found this uninvited guest extremely amusing. Even the mice hid behind the burly ogre, chattering "squeak squeak squeak". Of course, they only dared to laugh secretly and never dared to come near the cat.
